about: How a commander's camera names are drawn, and where the Camera Commander card puts its Talk chips: each commander's `labels`. Each option: label, help, default, and its range (with `step` where it takes halves) or its choices (neither: a colour). `name`: a name's size is a share of its place, never under its floor nor over its cap (CSS px: a floor is the least that can be read, and a name grows only a little on a very large screen); `tile_was` and `main_was` are the sides a size saved in px before 2026.11.14-b8 is read against. `picture`: which part of a cropped main camera is kept (the commander's `main_keep`). `fonts`: the file of each font but the standard one (Pillow's built-in), in the casa_mia component's www/fonts. Read by the compositor (compositor/labels.py), the app's checks, the cards (integration/cards/src/labels.ts) and the admin page. Not in layout.json, which Sensor Watch's cards bundle.

font.label: Font
font.help: The font the cameras' names are in. Standard is the one they were always in; a live main camera's name is then in the browser's own font.

tile_share.label: Tile name size, %
tile_share.help: The height of a tile's name, as a share of the shorter side of the commander's smallest tile, so the names are in proportion on a phone and on a large screen alike, and all the same size. Never under 11 px or over 22 px. A name too long for its tile is shortened, with … at its end.

main_share.label: Main camera name size, %
main_share.help: The height of the main camera's name and of the clock beside it, as a share of the shorter side of the main camera's place. Never under 13 px or over 30 px.

colour.label: Text colour
colour.help: The colour of the names and the clock.

opacity.label: Background opacity, %
opacity.help: How solid the colour behind a name is. 0 leaves the name alone on the picture.

tile_style.label: A tile's name
tile_style.help: Bar: across the foot of the tile. Pill: only as wide as the name. None: no name.

main_style.label: The main camera's name
main_style.help: Bar: across the foot of the main camera. Pill: only as wide as the name. None: no name; the clock stays.

talk_status.label: Call status at
talk_status.help: Where the call's state (ringing, answered, time left) goes over the main camera. Put it clear of the date and name your cameras write on their own picture.

talk_status_x.label: Call status, nudge across, px
talk_status_x.help: Moves the call's state sideways from where it is put: to the right, or to the left below 0.

talk_status_y.label: Call status, nudge down, px
talk_status_y.help: Moves the call's state down from where it is put, or up below 0.

talk_buttons.label: Talk buttons at
talk_buttons.help: Where the Talk and hold-to-talk buttons go over the main camera.

talk_buttons_x.label: Talk buttons, nudge across, px
talk_buttons_x.help: Moves the Talk buttons sideways from where it is put: to the right, or to the left below 0.

talk_buttons_y.label: Talk buttons, nudge down, px
talk_buttons_y.help: Moves the Talk buttons down from where it is put, or up below 0.

main_keep.label: Keep this part of the main camera
main_keep.help: When the main camera is cropped, in any layout, the crop keeps this part of its picture and comes off the opposite side. Top left keeps the date and time many cameras write there.
